title: Search Relevance Evaluation with LLM Judges

engineFeatures.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain

label: For "Search Relevance Evaluation with LLM Judges": Replace expensive human relevance labelling with calibrated LLM judges to evaluate ranking changes daily at scale. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Judge and ranker share a base model.
